All the employees were assigned to the conference room. Everyone was a little nervous. There were nearly two hundred employees, and each one had a different expression. Some were expectant, some excited, some disgusted, and some indifferent.

The headquarters will be located in mainland China. Those interested can sign up soon, and I'll arrange your travel. Employees who come to headquarters will receive additional allowances and subsidies. Furthermore, you must strictly adhere to my instructions. paragraphs: "Your ex-husband is in deep trouble right now and has no time for you. He's exposed all the senators he worked with and is now busy arresting those who committed corruption. He's not much better, having exposed some of Hollywood's problems, so he doesn't have time for you." Emma sat down and took out a cigarette and lit it. As a college student, she had already learned to smoke. And as a genius, smoking and drinking were quite enjoyable forms of entertainment, as long as she didn't have sex with her boyfriend.

Rebecca took out two bottles of beer, opened them, and handed one to her cousin. "That's good. Is he crazy? How could he do such a thing? This is good. It prevents him from staring at me any longer." She said this with a hint of relief that she had no feelings for her ex-husband.

Emma frowned, skeptical of Zhao An. She picked up an unopened bottle of beer and tried to open it with her bare hands, but failed. "According to the principles of physics, it should be possible. Are you strong enough?"
"Of course, what else do you expect?" Emma found it a bit amusing. What else could you buy here without US dollars?
"If he needs me, I'll go. Otherwise, I can't stay here. A woman always needs a man; one is enough." Rebecca took out her last two cigarettes, giving one to her cousin and one to herself.
"Working overtime tonight?"
Emma's eyes flickered at the sight of her barehanded beer bottle cap. She took the beer and asked curiously, "How did you do that?"
Emma didn't hesitate, stuffing the twenty thousand yuan into her backpack. A hint of reluctance crossed her pretty face. "You're going overseas with him, right?"

"Emma is my cousin. She's very smart, an engineering major, and a great ballet dancer," Rebecca introduced as she sat next to Zhao An. For some reason, it seemed as if she'd changed the moment she met Zhao An. She seemed to be more focused on him, less assertive.

"Sure." Rebecca smiled. She had no resistance to this man at all. She didn't know why, but she had no intention of objecting to anything he said, and she couldn't muster the energy to do so. It was truly strange.
Emma sniffed and looked at her beer. "Did you have sex with that man here last night?"

Rebecca blushed. "Do you have a dog nose? He came over last night, and I don't know how, I ended up sleeping with him. His penis is huge, bigger than most men's. He promised me that he would support my acting career."

The two sisters had nothing to hide. Rebecca provided much of Emma's funding, and they had a good relationship. At least Emma's family didn't want her to take expensive ballet classes. It was all thanks to Rebecca's support, so the two sisters had always had a good relationship. It was just that their mothers had some conflicts, so they didn't see each other often.

Ding-dong, the doorbell rang. Rebecca was about to say something, but when she reached the front door, she saw the man who had driven her to ecstasy last night through the peephole. Without hesitation, she opened the door.
Zhao An came in with two bags, both filled with beer and food.

"I never lie, and I don't need to. With my current status and wealth, I don't need to. You have a unique aura. I imagine you're a woman with a story. How about a drink for our new friend?" Zhao An opened three bottles of beer with his bare hands and handed one over.

Entering the living room, she saw Emma smoking. The sight of the blond, ponytailed beauty before her immediately caught her eye. "What a sight!" she thought. "What a beauty!" That rebellious aura was perfectly expressed. And yet, it also contained a certain intelligence. The two distinct qualities blended into a kind of aloofness, a solemn pride, a red rose that one could only want to conquer, a red rose with thorns!
"It's so easy, it's not difficult at all. First, you need a strong physique, then nimble hands." Zhao An demonstrated again, effortlessly and without any pressure.

"I know it's rare to find women majoring in engineering, let alone beautiful women. I've also studied engineering, and the factories of the future will undoubtedly be all mechanized assembly lines. The focus of machines is very cheap labor, and this kind of labor has a very low chance of failure. It's more reliable than manual labor, and leaving repetitive and boring tasks to machines is actually more effective." Zhao An put his arm around Rebecca's waist and spoke with the grace of a doctor in a professional field.

"He seems like an acceptable man. Maybe he'll come tonight. Do you have any money left? He gave me fifty thousand last night, and I don't need that much anyway." Rebecca took twenty thousand in cash from her room and handed it to her cousin. She was never stingy with her cousin.
"Hello, Zhao An," Zhao An said, extending his hand, a gentle smile on his face.
"You can try." Zhao An picked up the bottle and smiled, ignoring the other's questioning.

Emma picked up her beer and blew into it, feeling a bit heroic. She finished the beer and smoked a cigarette, puffing smoke rings with delight. "I've looked into that man, but there's not much information. I don't know the details, but it's true he's very wealthy. No one knows where his money comes from. He acquired Marvel Comics and Blizzard Entertainment. He spent nearly four billion, just to buy two companies. I don't understand what he's trying to do."
Emma simply glanced at Zhao An, frowning at his friendliness. She extended her delicate hand and shook his, a touch that lasted less than a second. "You're a liar. My name is Emma."
Rebecca's eyes flickered. "Four billion? US dollars?"

"Be good to my cousin, I hope you're not a liar." Emma said, and prepared to leave, not forgetting to pick up the stun gun on the table. She didn't want to be a third wheel here. She knew that passionate men and women would inevitably do something fancy together. Not having sex was just because the man was impotent. A strong man wouldn't leave a charming model alone. So it was best to leave as soon as possible. She didn't want to eavesdrop, and she didn't have the habit of doing so.

Zhao An's expression was quite smug, but after a moment's composure, he regained his composure, his expressionless expression of emotion and emotion.
This was the standard of negotiation.
"I understand.
I'll see you later," Zhao An said, closing the door.
A muscular woman with long red hair, tied back in a bun, gasped and looked at Zhao An with a lecherous look.
Her unique sensitivity could sense a man's foul desires, a sickening urge for mating.
If she saw a man like that, she would punch him in the nose and break his bones!

chapters.title: Chapter 339 Challenging the Muscular Woman
paragraphs: "Put away your eyeballs, or I'll gouge them out." Pence twisted her neck, making a clicking sound, her tone fierce yet tinged with a hint of coldness.

"I plan to hire you three as bodyguards, for life. I need not only ability, but also courage and strength. It's a buyout, with an annual salary of 30 million, plus benefits and other benefits, and future increases." Zhao An stated his recruitment conditions, quite generously. You have to remember that a mercenary doesn't make 10 million, at most 5 million. Mercenaries aren't robbers, and they don't earn that much. So 30 million a year is an exorbitant sum.

"Defeat us, and we'll accept your employment. There's no compensation for being maimed here, man. I'll give you one last chance to think it over." Pence removed his gloves and unleashed a punch, denting a steel plate. Five centimeters thick steel could actually be dented by a woman. This level of lethality might be acceptable on a man, but on a woman it would only be surprising and delightful.
"If you're a man, come up and fight us." Pence hooked his finger, his expression filled with contempt.
To his right, another sturdy white woman used her elbow as a weapon, a position that allowed her to concentrate even greater force, capable of piercing an adult's head with a single blow!

However, Zhao An showed no sign of discomfort. He grabbed the man's fist with his right hand and spun it. The immense force, coupled with the excruciating pain in his wrist, forced the man to follow suit, his entire body whirling under the immense inertia.
Zhao An, a certified surgical expert, was intimately familiar with every part of the human body. He could discern a man's weaknesses at a glance, regardless of his region.
Zhao An glanced around. From the mercenaries' expressions, he could tell he'd hit a wall. "Are we competing here? What? Shooting or fighting?"
"You're looking for death!" Pence angrily raised her right foot and kneed Zhao An, trying to break his balls. She had no idea what mercy meant. Anyone who dared to touch her must die!

Bang! Every time Zhao An dodged, he would unleash a lightning-fast punch, piercing the besieging muscular man's stomach. His strength surpassed that of an average human, his body enhanced to the extreme. A single blow robbed the opponent of his strength, and the excruciating pain in his stomach, even to the point of his intestines collapsing, was invisible, yet it could bring even the most battle-hardened mercenary to the ground.
Looking at the remaining three muscular women, Zhao An's eyes were filled with amusement. "Come on, all of you!"

"Come on!" Zhao An had barely finished speaking when a burly white man launched an attack, launching a punch at his abdomen. The direction and angle of the punch were bizarre, neither up nor down, hitting right between his lower abdomen and chest—a position that was difficult to defend against and awkward.
As soon as these words were spoken, several mercenaries came out in displeasure, clenching their fists, their joints crackling.

Zhao An wasn't spending nearly 100 million a year to buy three big horses to ride, but to assess their abilities. He wanted them to help train more female bodyguards. This is like the saying "eggs lay eggs," a steady supply. A long-term business. Otherwise, with 30 million, there are all sorts of women he can play with, so why bother with these big horses whose auras are so cold they can make men impotent? That murderous aura was real, never deceptive!

Seven mercenaries were brought down in less than five seconds. None of them could stand; they all collapsed, clutching their stomachs. Were it not for their unwavering willpower, they would have cried out.

The mercenaries present, both white and black, smiled intriguedly. These three women were a formidable match. Either attack them all together or leave them alone. Quite a few had been killed, and the most brutal of all was the one who dared to sever a customer's penis, severing it with a tactical dagger!

As Pence threw his punch, a muscular black woman with six-pack abs darted from the left and slid in to land a kick on the man's ankle, knocking him off balance and rendering him unable to defend against the attack.
He grabbed Pence's breasts and squeezed them vigorously. "They're so elastic! You'll feel so good fucking them!"
Pence was astonished to find that the woman could withstand their attacks so completely. It was as if the strength that could kill a cow with a single punch was completely shattered by the woman.
"Looking for death!" Pence roared, sprinting quickly, punching the man in the face.
Bang! Zhao An launched a kick, colliding with a mercenary who had used a flying kick.

"Three at a time? I'll take on ten, and then seven more. Who's up?" Zhao An adjusted his casual clothes, tightening the drawstrings around his body. The clothes, made of pure nanomaterials, looked ordinary, but they were actually fireproof, waterproof, and bulletproof. It's just that there's no need to show off such high-end stuff.

"Ah!" The black mercenary screamed, flying backwards faster than he had come, crashing into numerous treadmills and falling to the ground. His leg was oddly twisted, bent by the immense force. Fortunately, he'd been exercising regularly; if it were any other man, he'd probably have suffered a comminuted fracture!

Pence's eyes grew cold, like a female leopard sizing up prey, an extremely dangerous one. With a gesture, the two companions behind him exchanged glances and deployed their usual battle formation, used against powerful opponents. So far, no one has escaped their siege alive.

Bang! Zhao An didn't dodge, letting them strike him. One to the chest, one to the ankle, and one to the waist—a trifecta of attacks no man could defend against. If the kick succeeded, the man would likely slip and fall, landing right in the direction of the woman's elbow. The impact would have been fatal, potentially crippling him.
Bang! Zhao An slashed at Pence's neck with a knife-like blow. With incredible force and mastery of her meridians, he struck at acupuncture points, knocking her unconscious.

chapters.title: Chapter 340 Stop Fighting, I Give Up!
paragraphs: Evelyn and Domit exchanged glances, realizing they seemed to have met their match. Seeing their leader knocked unconscious, they weren't intimidated; instead, they attacked with even greater fervor.

Domit was a black woman, her slightly dark skin revealing her mixed heritage of white people, yet her black identity was still palpable. She had loved boxing since childhood, and even after becoming a mercenary, she preferred to resolve conflicts with her fists.
Zhao An didn't even glance at him, blocking with his right hand and deflecting his fists with his wrist. Domit threw numerous punches, each one swatting them aside with a clattering sound.

"I like your idea of cooperation, but put aside your petty thoughts. You know the only way to deal with me is overseas. So if you want to kill me and seize my technology, now's the perfect time. Want to try?" Zhao An smiled an inexplicably eerie smile. If it weren't for the two horns on his head, he'd probably be a living demon!
Pence muttered and cursed, "Come on together! Don't be a wimp! Use our second tactic!"

During the exchange, Evelyn, the other white woman, lifted her right foot, her long, muscular legs unleashing a powerful impact, capable of breaking even a five-centimeter-thick steel plate with a single kick.
"No need. We're willing to sign a contract with you," Pence said respectfully. A strong person could naturally command them, but a weaker one wouldn't stand a chance.
Only one black woman remained. Despite seeing her two companions knocked unconscious one after another, she continued to punch with all her might, each one aiming for the opponent's vital points.

Half an hour later, the three women were once again awakened by a splash of cold water. Zhao An remained motionless, unscathed. These battle-hardened mercenaries, with their vast combat experience, couldn't defeat a mere mortal like him. Despite being a mortal, his body was already so formidable it could withstand ordinary pistol fire. This wasn't his limit, far from it.
He walked to the nearby water dispenser and filled a glass of water.

Boom! A sharp wind roared. Zhao An twisted his body, instantly deflecting the opponent's knee strike. He released his grip on Pence's breast and, with a backhand, knocked Evelyn, still barely exhausted and barely regaining her strength, unconscious.
A minute later, the three were knocked unconscious one after another, only to be revived by a splash of cold water. Zhao An again extended a finger and hooked it, urging them to continue.
Bang, bang, bang! The constant sound of flesh colliding, and the occasional screams and shouts from the women, all testified to the intensity of the battle.

As Pence and the other two followed Zhao An out, the gym fell silent, leaving everyone stunned. It was unbelievable that a single individual could possess such exceptional combat prowess. Was he still human?

"One-eyed, I've got them three. Bring out the contract, and I'll give you the money." Zhao An took out a cigarette and lit it, appearing nonchalant. One-Eye had been watching the surveillance footage and had witnessed Zhao An's immense power. He pulled three contracts from the safe. "I don't care how much you pay them, but I hope you can give them a good ending, not treat them as expendable goods. Each one is $800 million. Pence is even more powerful, so she'll need $1 billion. These are the contracts they signed. Every industry has its own rules. This is for headquarters, and I can't give you a discount."

"Burn them. From now on, the three of you will follow me." Zhao An took out a lighter and handed it over, not caring about the contract at all. The three Pengs women exchanged a glance and took the lighter, which meant they were free.

"Still not admitting defeat? Okay, come on! I'll give you another chance, until you feel you're ready!" Zhao An made a hooking gesture, inviting the three women to attack together. It felt great to beat a strong woman to submission. "Jingfu, jingfu!" the crowd cheered!

The one-eyed white man laughed heartily. His orders were to eliminate the other party. The headquarters' decision was to forbid anyone from poaching him, let alone someone who had already learned the core secrets. Zhao An would absolutely not be allowed to leave.
Seeing Zhao An still clutching Pence's breast with one hand, Domit immediately launched a flurry of punches.
Looking at the three muscular beauties lying on the ground, Zhao An didn't let his bestial nature run wild. He could do it later, but now wasn't the time.
But each time, she was dodged, not hit. In just five seconds, she threw thirty punches, not a single one landing. Each one was blocked mid-strike, completely ineffective.
Zhao An held out the three documents. "Check to see if they are your indentures."
They were grateful that Zhao An had asked them to burn the contract; at least such an action would strengthen their goodwill. "This new boss doesn't seem so bad!"

In reality, this was truly a form of indenture. At least until they had completed a sufficient number of missions, they had no choice but to die in battle. If they forced their escape, they would be hunted down and ultimately dead, though at least within the rules, they could live a little longer.
"You're amazing! You have a lot of new technology. Perhaps you could collaborate with us." One-Eye glanced at his phone and handed over the documents.
"These days, there are always those useless guys occupying positions, doing nothing, but unable to die."
In the top-floor office, the one-eyed white man was still on the phone. Upon seeing Zhao An, he spoke hastily and hung up.

Boo! A cup of water was splashed in the faces of the three muscular women. The cold water chilled them, and they quickly jumped back to their feet. They assumed attacking stances, still unwilling to admit defeat.
The three Pence women took the contracts, examined them, and quickly nodded. "Yes, these are our contracts."

One-Eye had barely finished speaking when he received a signal. The money had arrived, incredibly quickly, almost as soon as he finished speaking. The funds were transferred through dozens of different accounts, incredibly quickly and without any loopholes.
"Get some sleep. You'll see what's going on soon," the black woman, Domit, said, watching the approaching hand strikes before she was knocked unconscious.

"He'll be dead soon. We can have a cup of tea and chat while we have time." Zhao An took out his phone and checked. It was almost time. He wanted to make an example of someone. He'd had enough of the female anchor, so now would be a good time to do something else.

chapters.title: Chapter 341 Happy Cooperation!
paragraphs: This gesture seemed to carry a message. The one-eyed white man ignored the incoming call on his phone, stood up, walked to the wine cabinet, and pulled out his prized wine. "This is something I got from a worthy rival. I've treasured it for a long time and never had the heart to drink it."
"You three go pack up and come with me later," Zhao An said to the three female bodyguards, continuing to play with his phone.

Bang! An explosion echoed from the company executive's office, and sirens blared, sending security into a state of emergency. Even the security chief, who was about to make a move, was startled. The explosion caused a slight tremor to be felt throughout the building.
The thought of acquiring more advanced technology to claim credit for it was incredibly exciting. At this level, the higher you go, the harder it gets.

"It's a pleasure to work with you. I've received word that headquarters has asked me to take over the bald man's duties and find the perpetrators of the headquarters attack," the one-eyed white man said, extending his hand.

"It's just so-so. That guy also dealt with me behind my back. Otherwise, Orias and Mike wouldn't have dared to deal with me so blatantly. I don't know why, but as long as he's dead, that's enough. I won't hold a dead man responsible." Zhao An blew out smoke rings, his expression even a little disdainful. Just a clown, nothing to be concerned about.

On the outskirts of a certain city, three linked buildings formed a strange landscape. Three skywalks separated the buildings, separated by windshields, eliminating the risk of being blown away. The strong winds at high altitudes are strong enough to blow away an adult weighing over 100 pounds. This is the risk of high-rise buildings. Increasingly strong winds make it less safe at altitude; it remains dangerous. The saying "it's cold at the top" is no joke.

The bald manager gazed out the window. Today's blue sky and white clouds seemed no different, the same as before, unchanged, except for a slightly different feel. "The sun is shining, shouldn't I find a chick to relieve my urges?"
Bullying? That's what they wanted. Otherwise, what was the point of all this high-tech stuff?

This is the headquarters of Bluewater Security, a security company with ties to the federal government. The former Philadelphia outskirts were merely a branch. Although both are in North America, the branch manages North America, while the headquarters oversees the overall situation.
Whoosh! The missile wasn't invisible. The bald manager's eyes widened at the sight, unsure why a small missile had suddenly appeared outside the window, right in front of his eyes.

Besides, tiny drones are difficult to detect, and radar scanning radiuses are standardized. Conventional and advanced methods alike could not detect Zhao An's drone, effectively forcing the outcome to a conclusion.

High above the clouds, a stealth drone flew at a rapid speed. Utilizing advanced glass-reflective technology, the drone's appearance was impossible to discern from below; it appeared completely transparent to human eyes. Super nanomaterials can absorb any sound waves, rendering them invisible even to radar.

The drone transmitted the entire commotion to Zhao An's phone, scanning the scene with infrared light to ensure that no traces were left. Not even tiny shrapnel would be left; this type of missile would completely destroy everything!

Boom! A series of detonations echoed, and the specially designed small missile transformed into a violent blast wave. It destroyed everything in the office, vaporizing the bald executive along with him.
A bald man sat in his office, gazing at the artificial lake outside, a glass of red wine in hand, feeling incredibly content. It felt good to be here, so refreshing.
After hanging up the phone, the one-eyed white man said respectfully, "Mr. Zhao, your methods are truly astonishing."

The one-eyed white man's phone began to vibrate. "I got a call. Excuse me." After answering the call, his expression became serious and strange. He looked at Zhao An, who was smoking and drinking, with an incredulous look. This partner was truly a shrewd fellow. He'd taken out his boss from a distance.
"Bomb attack on the 28th floor, immediate reinforcements!" the patrolling security guard called over the intercom.

At that moment, the office door opened. The three Pence women, who had returned from their previous trip, changed into tight leather jackets and pants, carrying backpacks. They looked refreshingly capable. They didn't even bring skincare products, nor did they need them; women who enjoy fitness don't need them.
Sitting in his office, Zhao An put away his phone. Using all this high-tech stuff to outmaneuver the other party—honestly, wasn't that a bit of a bully?

"What a fool! Unleashing your weapons on my territory! Haha, great! Once I've taken your stuff, your woman will be mine too!" the bald black man smirked. Men, after all, pursue power, wealth, and beauty. Without any such pursuits, what's a true man?
Even if he looked at his screen, all he could see was a bunch of gibberish. Even professional programmers couldn't understand what it meant, let alone anyone else. So, there was no worry about leaks.

At this point, the drone was slowly descending, landing proudly in front of the Blue Water Company, a security firm. Undetected even by the company's own sensors, it slowly descended from the top floor all the way to the 28th. It landed right in front of the bald manager, its fuselage folding, and a missile quickly extended.
The missile ignited, instantly flying to the window, punching a hole through the sturdy bulletproof windshield and plunging directly into the head of the bald executive, who couldn't wait any longer.
After the explosion, the drone took off again and flew back, unnoticed. No radar had detected it, not even the surveillance footage. There was no way to know what was going on.

"You know what to do. Tomorrow, some organization might claim responsibility for the attack on the federal camp. No one can avoid the publicity. Contact me if you need anything. I'm leaving now." Zhao An shook hands with them, not even explaining the details of the partnership; he simply confirmed it and left. It was a bit anticlimactic, but they both understood that as long as they could work together, the details could be worked out later.
